content:
The hemisphere of radius \(200\) is the upper half of the sphere  

\[
x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\le 200^{2},\qquad z\ge 0 .
\]

For a point \(P=(x,y,0)\) in the base disk we place a sphere of radius \(42\) so that it is tangent to the plane at \(P\).  
Hence the small sphere’s centre is  

\[
C=(x,y,42).
\]

The small sphere lies completely inside the hemisphere iff it lies completely inside the big sphere.  
Thus the distance from the origin to \(C\) must satisfy  

\[
\text{dist}(O,C)+42\le 200 .
\]

Equivalently  

\[
\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+42^{2}}\le 200-42=158 .
\]

Squaring gives  

\[
x^{2}+y^{2}\le 158^{2}-42^{2}= (158-42)(158+42)=116\cdot200=23200 .
\]

So the region \(\mathcal T\) is a disk of radius \(\sqrt{23200}=20\sqrt{58}\) centred at the origin.

The area of \(\mathcal T\) is \(\pi(20\sqrt{58})^{2}= \pi\cdot23200\).  
The area of the whole base disk is \(\pi\cdot200^{2}= \pi\cdot40000\).

Hence the required ratio of areas is  

\[
\frac{23200}{40000}= \frac{58}{100}= \frac{29}{50}.
\]

Thus \(\displaystyle \frac{p}{q}= \frac{29}{50}\) with relatively prime \(p=29,\;q=50\).

\[
p+q=29+50=79.
\]

\[
\boxed{79}
\]
